construct: ::part(label) styling across an OPEN shadow boundary
why: The sanctioned theming seam for web components: the page restyles internals it does not own. MEASURED: the shadow-walking reader introduced for the web-components round descends OPEN roots, and getComputedStyle resolves ::part() styling like any other rule — so this is carried. Kept as a case because the carriage is INCIDENTAL (nothing in the pipeline knows what a part() seam IS) and would be lost the moment the walker changed.

canvas.note: the restyled internal is real ink, and it is carried
